title: Build deterministic pagination plans
description: Derive stable multi-sheet pages from ordered assignments and selected available positions, then feed the same immutable PaginationPlan to sheet preview and PDF generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Assignments exceeding one sheet produce a PaginationPlan with stable page and position identities
Pagination consumes TASK-47 order and explicit TASK-48 selections without hidden compaction
Equivalent normalized inputs produce deeply equal plans across repeated runs and reloads
Sheet preview and PDF generation consume the same plan rather than repaginating independently
Invalid capacity, stale positions, or unresolved assignments return named diagnostics and no partial plan

steps.details: Add a serializable derived value containing ordered pages, stable destination positions, source assignment identities, and generation diagnostics.
Fill explicit available positions in canonical order, advance pages deterministically, and preserve source assignment order without mutating project records.
Pass the completed plan to sheet preview and PDF preparation seams and remove adapter-local page/position allocation.
Cover zero, exact-capacity, overflow, sparse, stale-position, and multi-page cases; assert repeated plan equality and matching preview/PDF page-position sequences.

technicalNotes: Timebox to one pure fill algorithm and shared adapter input; progress UI for large plans can be a later performance refinement.
Pagination order does not establish a safe physical sheet-loading or refeeding procedure.
